insight.master-calligrapher.why: Increase active Ink Mark maximum by +2; marks last 8 hours unless shorter.

insight.brush-armed-guard.why: When Brushstroke Shield reduces damage to 0, optionally place a simple Ink Mark on the visible attacker within 60 feet.

tianxia.talent.ink.vermilion_correction.why: React to a marked creature ability check within 30 feet: add or subtract 1d4 before outcome; 1 CP; once per round per recipient.
